identity: The same 43-year-old Chinese woman from Chongqing as the reference: 163 cm, slim-average build, gentle smile lines, faint crow's feet, noticeably full lips, dark brown shoulder-length waves worn down with a few fine grey strands. Do not make her younger or rounder-faced.
stylization: Character stylization (A2, pushed): she must read instantly as an animated 3D feature-film character, never as a real woman. Noticeably enlarged expressive eyes with clear irises and soft catchlights; gently simplified, softly exaggerated facial shapes; smooth stylized skin shading with soft subsurface scattering and no pores; hair sculpted into clean grouped clumps. Realistic adult head-to-body proportions, about 7 heads tall; normal head size.
